reuse.why: Uses the shared extractTagsFromText for tag parsing and plugs the new exclusion into the existing month-fill selection next to getTemplatedCategoryIds.

duplication.why: The exclusion set is built once in getManagedCategoryIds; copyPreviousMonth still composes isMonthFillCategory plus the exclusion set itself (pre-existing), so the combination is spelled twice.

placement.why: Selection logic stays in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-fill helpers; tag parsing comes from shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the new exclusion, its wiring into the two selection paths, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A clear 'managed categories' concept that future exclusions can extend; the LIKE prefilter is a harmless optimisation guarded by the real tag check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses extractTagsFromText and getMonthFillCategories; copyPreviousMonth's own composition predates the change and is updated to the shared set.

one_place.where: actions.ts getManagedCategoryIds (templated + #fixed group ids) is used by getMonthFillCategories and by copyPreviousMonth, so every month-wide action applies the rule from one definition.
